text_block_list.text:
One day, with the "Arima Kinen"
and the showdown against Grass Wonder
looming just ahead...

To work out a strategy for race day, we set aside time
to watch and study Grass Wonder's race footage, but...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Rounding the fourth corner, coming from the outside,
Grass Wonder! Here comes Grass Wonder!
Grass Wonder charges across the finish line!!”
(WAAAAAAAH...!!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
choice_data_list: Spe, what's wrong...?
Spe, what's wrong...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
I...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ……I'm going for a run!!
choice_data_list: Huh?!

text_block_list.text: Special Week suddenly rushed out of the room!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Haa, ngh...!!

With a cornered look on her face,
Special Week ran lap after lap around the track.

However, she had already finished
today's training menu.
choice_data_list: That's overwork, Spe!
That's overwork, Spe!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ……Please leave me alone.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I can't let it end like this.
...Please, let me run!
choice_data_list: No good!
No way!

text_block_list.text: Without thinking, I stepped in front of her as she tried to force herself to run.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...What are you doing, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Standing in front of a sprinting Umamusume
is practically the same as jumping into traffic, you know?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If you get shoved by me and end up hurt,
don't come crying to me...!!
choice_data_list: Even so, I won't let you pass.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
choice_data_list: Because I'm your trainer!
Because I'm your trainer!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...
Trainer...
choice_data_list: Don't carry it all alone. Let's talk it out.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... uuu.
Uuuuugh~...!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Waaaahhh...!!

Special Week collapsed onto the track just like that
and kept crying for quite some time...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, Trainer.
Just now, I... said something awful..."
choice_data_list: Did watching Grass run make you feel pressured?
Did watching Grass run make you anxious?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...You see right through me, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I thought I understood.
Just how strong Grass-chan is.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Still, when I look at them imagining we're actually going head-to-head—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Her speed, her stamina, her eye for
picking the right moment... everything was truly, truly incredible."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I thought that, as I am right now, I might not stand a chance, that I might lose...!
choice_data_list: I don't see it that way.
I don't think so.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...How could you say such a thing?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
In the Twinkle Series...
There are so many girls who are way more talented,
faster, and stronger than me!!
choice_data_list: Still, the one I chose was you!
Still, you're the one I chose!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah...
choice_data_list: You're the one I've been watching over by your side all this time.
You're the one I've been watching over all this time

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Always... by your side...
choice_data_list: That was a great run in the Japan Derby.
That was a great run in the Japan Derby, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
choice_data_list: The "Tenno Sho (Spring)" was amazing too!
The "Tenno Sho (Spring)" was amazing too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
choice_data_list: So you'll be just fine even in the Arima Kinen.
That's why the Arima Kinen will be fine too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...You really believe in me,
don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That I... can make my dream come true.
choice_data_list: It's been like that right from the very start.
It's been like that right from the very start.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, that is true.
...Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm going home for today.
Go home, eat, and get lots of sleep."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
And so—I'll do my best again tomorrow!
I'll run towards becoming the best Umamusume in Japan!

Special Week's carefree smile undeniably shone
with the very same sparkle as when we first met.
